grok-diagnostic.reason.notFound: The Grok Build executable was not found.
grok-diagnostic.reason.unsupported: The native protocol or version is incompatible.
grok-diagnostic.reason.unavailable: The native operation failed or timed out.
grok-diagnostic.reason.resourceExhausted: The native output exceeded its bound.
grok-diagnostic.reason.conflict: The operation conflicts with an existing owner.
grok-diagnostic.reason.other: The native operation did not complete.
grok-diagnostic.reason.versionSupported: Grok Build requires valid SemVer at or above {{supported}}.
grok-diagnostic.reason.versionInvalid: The native version metadata is invalid.
grok-diagnostic.guidance.install: Install the supported Grok Build release shown below on the selected Runner Device, then refresh protocol discovery. No account execution was authorized.
grok-diagnostic.guidance.access: Restore OS permission for the Grok Build executable, its private runtime and its owned process, then refresh protocol discovery. Keep the account and original operation.
grok-diagnostic.guidance.operation: Keep the original account and operation. Check the Grok Build installation in Worker diagnostics before starting another sign-in or native operation.
grok-diagnostic.copyFailed: The reference could not be copied.
grok-diagnostic.guidance.server: Grok sign-in runs on the DeliDev server. Keep the original account and operation. Check the Grok Build installation on that server before retrying.
